([[Bellevue, Nebraska]]) | college = * [[Wisconsin Badgers men's basketball|Wisconsin]] (2021–2024) * [[Louisville Cardinals men's basketball|Louisville]] (2024–2025) | draft_year = 2025 | career_start = 2025 | years1 = {{nbay|2025|start}}–present | team1 = [[Toronto Raptors]] | years2 = [[2025–26 NBA G League season|2025]]–present | team2 = →[[Raptors 905]] | highlights = * ACC Defensive Player of the Year (2025) * First-team [[List of All-Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball teams|All-ACC]] (2025) * [[Big Ten Conference|Big Ten]] All-Defensive Team ([[2023–24 Big Ten Conference men's basketball season|2024]]) * Big Ten All-Freshman Team ([[2021–22 Big Ten Conference men's basketball season|2022]]) }} '''Gabriel Malik''' "'''Chucky'''" ''' Hepburn''' (born February 9, 2003) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Toronto Raptors]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA), on a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Raptors 905]] of the [[NBA G League]]. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Wisconsin Badgers men's basketball|Wisconsin Badgers]] and the [[Louisville Cardinals men's basketball|Louisville Cardinals]]. ==Early life and high school career== Hepburn grew up in [[Omaha, Nebraska]], and attended [[Bellevue West High School]]. As a sophomore, Hepburn averaged 18.3 points, five assists, 5.1 rebounds, and 3.4 steals per game.{{cite web |date=March 12, 2022 |title=Chucky Hepburn page |url=https://www.maxpreps.com/ne/bellevue/bellevue-west-thunderbirds/athletes/chucky-hepburn/basketball/stats/?careerid=rguau71rjjtj3 |access-date=January 7, 2024 |work=[[MaxPreps]]}} Hepburn won the 2020 Nebraska Mr. Basketball Gatorade Player of the Year.{{cite web |date=April 13, 2020 |title=Chucky Hepburn Mr. Basketball Gatorade Player of the Year |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/highschool/awards/1/74 |access-date=January 7, 2024 |work=RealGM}} He guided Bellevue West to a Class A state title as a junior, averaging 17.1 points, 6.5 assists, 4.6 rebounds, and 3.1 steals per game. He averaged 15.9 points, 8.3 assists, 5.1 rebounds, and 3.8 steals per game as a senior as Bellevue West appeared in the Class A state title. ===Recruiting=== {{College Athlete Recruit career== ===Wisconsin=== Hepburn enrolled at [[University of Wisconsin–Madison]] after receiving offers from [[Nebraska Cornhuskers men's basketball|Nebraska]], [[Creighton Bluejays men's basketball|Creighton]], [[Minnesota Golden Gophers men's basketball|Minnesota]], [[Loyola Ramblers men's basketball|Loyola (IL)]] and [[Valparaiso Beacons men's basketball|Valparaiso]].{{cite web|url=https://n.rivals.com/content/athletes/chucky-hepburn-219489?view=pv|title=Hepburn|website=Rivals|date=September 29, 2021|access-date=January 7, 2024}} ====Freshman season==== Hepburn became the first true freshman to start the season opener since [[Devin Harris]] in 2001.{{cite web|url=https://wisconsin.rivals.com/news/notes-wisconsin-freshman-chucky-hepburn-likely-to-start-opener-tuesday|title= Wisconsin Freshman Likely to Start Season Opener Tuesday|website=Rivals|date=November 8, 2021|access-date=January 15, 2024}} He went on to score 13 points in his first career game against [[St. Francis Brooklyn Terriers men's basketball|St. Francis]].{{cite web|url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/boxscores/2021-11-09-20-wisconsin.html|title=St. Francis (NY) vs. Wisconsin Box Score|website=sports-reference.com|date=November 9, 2021|access-date=January 15, 2024}} Hepburn banked in a tiebreaking 3-pointer with 1.5 seconds left against #8 ranked [[2021–22 Purdue Boilermakers men's basketball team|Purdue]], giving the Badgers a share of the Big Ten regular-season title.{{cite web|url=https://apnews.com/article/sports-march-madness-mens-college-basketball-college-basketball-wisconsin-c36a3c923a339cb20bc5d04848bbb362|title=No. 10 Badgers nip No. 10 Purdue for share of Big Ten title|website=apnews.com|date=March 2, 2022|access-date=January 15, 2024}} Hepburn was able to profit in the newly implemented [[Student athlete compensation|NIL]] after the game-winning shot against Purdue with merchandise named "The Chucky Special".{{cite web|url=https://finance.yahoo.com/news/how-name-image-and-likeness-will-change-march-madness-141250612.html|title=March Madness: The 'Chucky Special' shows how NIL will play in the Big Dance|website=Yahoo Finance|date=March 18, 2022|access-date=January 15, 2024}} After the regular season, Hepburn was named to the [[Big Ten Conference|Big Ten]] All–Freshman Team.{{cite web|url=https://bigten.org/news/2022/3/8/2021-22-big-ten-mens-basketball-postseason-honors-announced.aspx|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220308180525/https://bigten.org/news/2022/3/8/2021-22-big-ten-mens-basketball-postseason-honors-announced.aspx|url-status=dead|archive-date=March 8, 2022|title=2021–22 Big Ten Men's Basketball Postseason Honors Announced|website=[[Big Ten Conference]]|date=March 8, 2022|access-date=January 25, 2024}} ====Sophomore season==== Hepburn was asked to take on a larger role in his second season at Wisconsin after [[Johnny Davis (basketball, born 2002)|Johnny Davis]] was selected 10th overall by the [[Washington Wizards]]. Hepburn started all 35 games and was the Badgers' leading scorer (12.2 points per game), 3-point percentage (.405), assists (2.8 APG), and steals (1.5 SPG). The team struggled with injuries midway through the season, and Wisconsin missed the [[NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]]. Following the conclusion of the regular season, Hepburn was named an All–Big Ten honorable mention selection.{{cite web|url=https://bigten.org/news/2023/3/7/general-2023-big-ten-mens-basketball-postseason-honors-announced.aspx|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230307181941/https://bigten.org/news/2023/3/7/general-2023-big-ten-mens-basketball-postseason-honors-announced.aspx|url-status=dead|archive-date=March 7, 2023|title=2023 Big Ten Men's Basketball Postseason Honors Announced|website=[[Big Ten Conference]]|date=March 7, 2023|access-date=January 25, 2024}} The Badgers accepted an invitation to the [[2023 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]] where Hepburn scored a career-high 27 points in a second round victory against [[2022–23 Liberty Flames basketball team|Liberty]].{{cite web|url=https://badgerextra.com/sports/basketball/men/wisconsin-chucky-hepburn-playmaker/article_e05ecafe-1cf9-11ee-b7dc-ebb7da3ac609.html|title=Rewatching Chucky Hepburn's offensive playmaking reveals strengths, areas to grow|website=badgersextra.com|date=July 14, 2023|access-date=January 15, 2024}} ====Junior season==== Hepburn came into his junior season and has thrived in the role of facilitator and defender.{{cite web|url=https://wisconsin.rivals.com/news/chucky-hepburn-loving-his-role-of-wisconsin-badgers-facilitator|title=Chucky Hepburn Loving his Role of Wisconsin Badgers' Facilitator|website=wisconsin.rivals.com|date=January 11, 2024|access-date=January 25, 2024}} The previous season, he was looked at by his teammates as the "go to guy" to score late in shot clock or late in games. With the additions of scorers [[AJ Storr]] and freshman [[John Blackwell (basketball)|John Blackwell]], Hepburn has been able to refine other parts of his game. Evidence of this is Chucky has put up his best assist to turnover ratio of his career and uptick in steals. Following the completion of the regular season, Hepburn was named All-Big Ten honorable mention by the coaches and named to the All-Defensive Team.{{cite web|url=https://bigten.org/news/2024/3/12/general-big-ten-announces-2024-mens-basketball-postseason-honors.aspx|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240312183111/https://bigten.org/news/2024/3/12/general-big-ten-announces-2024-mens-basketball-postseason-honors.aspx|url-status=dead|archive-date=March 12, 2024|title=Big Ten Announces 2024 Men’s Basketball Postseason Honors|website=[[Big Ten Conference]]|date=March 12, 2024|access-date=March 13, 2024}} ===Louisville=== ====Senior season==== On April 25, 2024, Hepburn announced he would be transferring to [[Louisville Cardinals men's basketball|Louisville]].{{Cite web |last=Cobb |first=David |date=April 25, 2024 |title=What Chucky Hepburn's commitment means for Louisville basketball as Pat Kelsey lands ex-Wiscconsin guard |url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/what-chucky-hepburns-commitment-means-for-louisville-basketball-as-pat-kelsey-lands-ex-wiscconsin-guard/ |access-date=May 6, 2024 |website=CBS Sports }}{{Cite web |title=Kelsey Adds Wisconsin Transfer Chucky Hepburn |url=https://gocards.com/news/2024/5/29/mens-basketball-kelsey-adds-wisconsin-transfer-chucky-hepburn |access-date=May 29, 2024 |website=University of Louisville Athletics }} Hepburn scored a career high 37 points against [[2024–25 Pittsburgh Panthers men's basketball team|Pittsburgh]] on March 1, 2025. He was named [[2024–25 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC]] player of the week for the second time during the 2024–25 season.{{Cite web |title=Louisville basketball's Chucky Hepburn named ACC Player of the Week after 37-piece vs Pitt |url=https://www.courier-journal.com/story/sports/college/louisville/2025/03/03/louisville-basketball-chucky-hepburn-pitt-stats-highlights-pat-kelsey/81154922007/ |access-date=March 1, 2025 |website=courier-journal.com }} Hepburn averaged 16.4 points, 5.8 assists and 2.4 steals per game. He was named ACC Defensive Player of the Year.{{cite web |last1=Harbsmeier |first1=Deborah |title=Chucky Hepburn takes his talents to Toronto in two-way deal |url=https://spectrumnews1.com/ky/louisville/news/2025/06/27/chucky-hepburn-contract |website=Spectrum News |access-date=December 9, 2025 |date=June 27, 2025}} ==Professional career== On July 1, 2025 after going undrafted in the [[2025 NBA draft]], Hepburn signed a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Toronto Raptors]].{{Cite web |title=Toronto Raptors Sign Standout Defensive Guard Chucky Hepburn |url=https://www.si.com/nba/raptors/toronto-raptors-sign-chucky-hepburn-to-two-way-contract |access-date=June 29, 2025 |website=si.com }} On January 8, 2026, Hepburn was ruled out for at least six weeks after undergoing surgery to repair a [[meniscus tear|torn meniscus]] in his right knee.{{Cite web|title=Raptors rookie guard Hepburn undergoes meniscus surgery|url=https://www.sportsnet.ca/nba/article/raptors-rookie-guard-hepburn-undergoes-meniscus-surgery/|access-date=January 19, 2026|website=sportsnet.ca|language=en}} ==Career statistics== {{NBA
